Four Students Killed, One Injured in Train Collision in Andhra Pradesh

Four youths were struck by the Rajya Rani Express in Srikakulam district of Andhra Pradesh, killing them and critically injuring a fifth. The victims, identified as intermediate students, were crossing the railway tracks while fishing in flood‑water when the train hit them.
